$(function(){

    function trackReturns() {

	    function dayDiff(d1, d2) {

		    return Math.floor((d1-d2)/86400000);

	    }



	    var cookieName = 'RBXReturn';

	    var cookieOptions = {expires:9001};

        var cookie = $.getJSONCookie(cookieName);



	    if (typeof cookie.ts === "undefined" || isNaN(new Date(cookie.ts))) {

		    $.setJSONCookie(cookieName, {ts:new Date().toDateString()}, cookieOptions)

		    return;

	    }



	    var daysSinceFirstVisit = dayDiff(new Date(), new Date(cookie.ts));

	    if (daysSinceFirstVisit == 1 && typeof cookie.odr === "undefined") {

		    RobloxEventManager.triggerEvent('rbx_evt_generic', { type:'OneDayReturn'});

		    cookie.odr = 1;

	    }

	    if (daysSinceFirstVisit >= 1 && daysSinceFirstVisit <= 7 && typeof cookie.sdr === "undefined") {

		    RobloxEventManager.triggerEvent('rbx_evt_generic', {type: 'SevenDayReturn'});

		    cookie.sdr = 1;

	    }

	

	    $.setJSONCookie(cookieName, cookie, cookieOptions);

    }

            };

            CapturePersonalInfoNagScreen.init = function () {

                var modalProperties = { escClose: false, opacity: 80, overlayCss: { backgroundColor: "#000"} };

                if (showPrompt) {

                    $("#CapturePersonalInfoNagScreen").modal(modalProperties);

                }

            };



            $('#ClosePersonalInfoNagScreen').click(function () {

                CapturePersonalInfoNagScreen.close(infoRequired);

            });



            $('#DismissInfoNagScreen').click(function () {

                CapturePersonalInfoNagScreen.close(infoRequired);

            });



            $('#UpdateInfoButton').click(function () {

                var gender = parseInt($('#GenderDropDown option:selected').val());

                var year = parseInt($('#YearDropDown option:selected').val());

                var month = parseInt($('#MonthDropDown option:selected').val());

                var day = parseInt($('#DayDropDown option:selected').val());



                if (year > 0 && month > 0 && day > 0 && day <= new Date(year, month, 0).getDate()) {

                    $.ajax({

                        type: "POST",

                        url: "/Services/UserCheck.asmx/UpdatePersonalInfo",

                        data: JSON.stringify({ genderId : gender, birthYear : year, birthMonth : month, birthDay : day }),

                        contentType: "application/json; charset=utf-8"

                    });

            

                    CapturePersonalInfoNagScreen.close();

                }

                else {

                    $('#InvalidDate').show();

                }

            });



            CapturePersonalInfoNagScreen.init();

        });

    </script>



</div>

<script type="text/javascript" language="javascript">

    function toggleDropDownNav()

    {

        if ($(".dropdownnavcontainer:visible").size() > 0)

        {

            $(".dropdownnavcontainer").hide();

            $("#gamesMenuToggle").css("background-position", "0 0");

        }

        else

        {

            $(".dropdownnavcontainer").show();

            $("#gamesMenuToggle").css("background-position", "0 -6px");

        }

    }

</script>

        <script type="text/javascript" language="javascript">

            function limitText(limitField, limitNum)

            {

                if (limitField.value.length > limitNum) 

                {

                    limitField.value = limitField.value.substring(0, limitNum);

                }

                $('#CharsRemaining').html(Math.max(0, Math.min(200, limitNum - limitField.value.length)) + " characters remaining");

            }

        </script>

    <script type="text/javascript">

        

        $("#Tabs").tabs();



        

            $("#CommentaryTabHeader").addClass("StandardTabGrayActive");

             $("#CommentaryTab").show();

        



        var commentsLoaded = false;



        $("#UserSalesLink").click(function () {

            $(".ItemTabs").removeClass("StandardTabGrayActive");

            $(".ItemTabs").addClass("StandardTabGray");

            $("#UserSalesTabHeader").addClass("StandardTabGrayActive");

            $("#ScriptReviewTab").hide();

        });



        $("#ScriptReviewLink").click(function () {

            $(".ItemTabs").removeClass("StandardTabGrayActive");

            $(".ItemTabs").addClass("StandardTabGray");

            $("#ScriptReviewTabHeader").addClass("StandardTabGrayActive");

            $("#ScriptReviewTab").show();

        });



        $("#CommentaryLink").click(function () {

            $(".ItemTabs").removeClass("StandardTabGrayActive");

            $(".ItemTabs").addClass("StandardTabGray");

            $("#CommentaryTabHeader").addClass("StandardTabGrayActive");

            $("#ScriptReviewTab").hide();

            $("#CommentaryTab").show()

            if (!commentsLoaded) {

                __doPostBack('ctl00$cphRoblox$CommentsPane$LoadCommentsButton','');

                commentsLoaded = true;

            }

            return false;

        });

        

        function confirmDelete() {

            return confirm("Are you sure you want to permanently DELETE this item from your inventory?");

        }



        function confirmSubmit() {

            var resp = confirm("This will add a new badge giver model to your inventory. Are you sure you want to do this?");

            if (resp) {

                window.location.href = $('#ctl00_cphRoblox_btnSubmit').attr('href');

            }

        }



        function getItem(view) {

            switch(view) {

                case "PurchaseFree":

                    $('#ctl00_cphRoblox_Button2').click();

                    break;

                case "PurchaseRobux":

                    $('#ctl00_cphRoblox_Button3').click();

                    break;

                case "UAPurchaseRobux":

                    $('#ctl00_cphRoblox_Button4').click();

                    break;

                case "PurchaseTickets":

                    $('#ctl00_cphRoblox_Button5').click();

                    break;

            }

        }

        function ModalClose(popup) {

            $.modal.close('.' + popup);

        }



        function UpdateSets(assetSetItemId, updateAllSets)

        {

            $.get(

                "/Sets/SetHandler.ashx?rqtype=getnewestversion&assetSetItemId=" + assetSetItemId + (updateAllSets ? "&allsets=true" : ""),

                function()

                {

                    $('#ctl00_cphRoblox_UpdateSet').hide("slow");

                    if (updateAllSets)

                    {

                        $('#ctl00_cphRoblox_updateSetsDiv').slideToggle("slow");

                    }

                });

        }
